items.title: Octave Crosby Interview
items.q: Chinese used to play with Papa Celestein years ago.

ctx.x: Chinese used to play with Papa Celestein years ago. Yeah, his name is Foster, don't you? Yeah, Oral Foster. What's his first name? I never did know nothing but Chinese.
